title: Starting young among older musicians
summary: He stresses he started very young, playing with Kid Renee at 13-14, and has a good memory of the old days.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Yeah, well, like I was saying, you see, I could talk about a lot of those old things, and I mean, I consider myself young as far as the jazz age is concerned. You understand? But the thing about it, I started out so young. Yeah, you remember right back. You see? And I got pretty good memories, I mean, as far as that. You know what I mean? I started out young. You see, when I was 13, 14 years old, I mean, as I said before, I was playing with Kid Renan, all them people. You see? Where the average boy at that time, 12, 13, 14 years old boy, 9 o'clock at night, they had to be in the bed.
You know, I just wanted to find out where he was.

Oh, see? So, I mean, that's why, I mean, a lot of people say, well, he's older than what he say he is. But that's not so. You understand? The thing about it, I started out so young. Yeah. And I was always interested. I was always with those type of fellas, where the other fella, he can't remember that because he wasn't interested. You understand? See? Well, let's see, where was that? Yeah. WPA man.
